features.name: Hands Of The Maker, Crafting Skill
features.description: Hands Of The Maker, Crafting Skill

features.name: Hands Of The Maker
features.description: You can craft objects with the power of your mind.

ability.name: Hands Of The Maker
ability.description: You can craft objects with the power of your mind.

sections.text: You create a mundane object of size 1S or smaller. You can maintain a number of objects created this way equal to your Intuition score. You can destroy an object created this way with a thought, no matter how far you are from it (no action required).

features.name: Statue of Power
features.description: A marble statue of your deity rises from the earth.

ability.name: Statue of Power
ability.description: A marble statue of your deity rises from the earth.

sections.text: A size 2 statue rises out of the ground in an unoccupied space within distance and lasts until the end of the encounter. While within 3 squares of the statue, you gain 1 surge at the start of each of your turns. Each ally within 3 squares of the statue gains this same benefit. The statue is destroyed if it takes 20 or more damage. It has immunity all to poison and psychic damage.

features.name: Improved Hands of the Maker
features.description: When you use your Hands of the Maker ability, you can create a mundane object that is size 2 or smaller.

features.name: Gods’ Machine
features.description: You conjure a whirring tank made of blades and metal.

ability.name: Gods’ Machine
ability.description: You conjure a whirring tank made of blades and metal.

sections.text: You conjure a size 2 rolling machine that appears in an unoccupied space within distance. The machine has 50 Stamina and immunity all to poison and psychic damage. It disappears at the end of the encounter, if its Stamina drops to 0, or if you are dying. When the machine first appears, make the following power roll once, targeting each enemy adjacent to it.
Once on each subsequent turn, you can use a free maneuver to move the machine a number of squares up to your Intuition score then repeat the power roll.

features.name: Divine Quartermaster
features.description: Each time you finish a respite, you can choose a treasure with a project goal equal to 50 times your level or less. You gain a divine version of this treasure that lasts until you finish another respite or it is consumed.

features.name: Divine Dragon
features.description: From nothing but divine will, you create a powerful ally.

ability.name: Divine Dragon
ability.description: From nothing but divine will, you create a powerful ally.

sections.text:
You conjure a size 4 dragon that appears in an unoccupied space within distance. The dragon has speed 6 and can fly, stability 4, 100 Stamina, immunity all to fire damage, and uses your characteristics. The dragon disappears at the end of the encounter, if their Stamina drops to 0, or if you are dying.

On subsequent turns, you can use a main action to command the dragon to breathe magic fire in a 3 cube within 1 square of them. Make the following power roll targeting each enemy in the area.

Additionally, you can use a maneuver to move the dragon up to their speed, or to make a melee weapon strike with their claw against an adjacent creature or object. The dragon can also make this strike as a free strike.

resourceGains.trigger: The first time in an encounter that a creature within 10 squares of you uses an area ability.

defaultFeatures.name: Creation Prayer Effect
defaultFeatures.description: You summon the forces of creation and create a wall of stone within 10 squares whose size is 5 + your Intuition score. The wall lasts until the end of the encounter.

features.name: Grave Speech, Lore Skill
features.description: Grave Speech, Lore Skill

features.name: Grave Speech
features.description: You commune with the lingering soul of the recently dead.

ability.name: Grave Speech
ability.description: You commune with the lingering soul of the recently dead.

sections.text: You can speak to the target if they are a creature who has died within the last 24 hours and who can speak a language you know, even if they are just a head. The target regards you as they would have in life, and you might need to make tests to influence them and convince them to speak with you. The trauma of dying can make a creature’s memory of that event hazy, but the target otherwise knows all they knew in life. After 1 minute, the effect ends. You can’t use this ability on the same creature twice.

features.name: Reap
features.description: The gods reward those who smite their foes.

ability.name: Reap
ability.description: The gods reward those who smite their foes.

sections.text: Until the start of your next turn, each time a target kills an enemy, they regain Stamina equal to 5 + your Intuition score.

features.name: Seance
features.description: You can commune with a network of spirits. As a respite activity, you speak the name of a creature who died and isn’t undead. If the creature’s spirit is free and willing to speak with you, they appear and you can have a conversation with them. During this time, the creature responds to you as they would have in life. If the creature isn’t free or willing to appear, you can speak another name or choose another respite activity.

features.name: Aura of Souls
features.description: A whirlwind of souls of the dead flies around you at your command.

ability.name: Aura of Souls
ability.description: A whirlwind of souls of the dead flies around you at your command.

sections.text: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, at the end of each of your turns, you can slide each creature in the area up to a number of squares equal to your Intuition score. This forced movement ignores stability for your allies.

features.name: Word of Death Deferred
features.description:
You can stop death from taking your allies. When an ally within distance of your Healing Grace ability dies and you are not dying, you can use a free triggered action to instead have that ally fall unconscious until they regain Stamina.

Additionally, your abilities deal an extra 5 damage to winded creatures.

features.name: Word of Final Redemption
features.description: Your death will fuel our victory.

ability.name: Word of Final Redemption
ability.description: Your death will fuel our victory.

sections.text: Before the target dies, you can look at their stat block and force them to use one ability that is a main action or a maneuver. If the ability costs a Heroic Resource or Malice, the creature can use it without any cost. For the purpose of using this ability, your allies and enemies are the target’s allies and enemies, and you decide who the ability targets.

resourceGains.trigger: The first time in an encounter that a creature within 10 squares who isn’t a minion is reduced to 0 Stamina, or the first time in an encounter that a solo creature within 10 squares becomes winded.

defaultFeatures.name: Death Prayer Effect
defaultFeatures.description: You inflict a deadly curse upon up to two enemies within 10 squares of you. Each target takes corruption damage equal to twice your Intuition score.

features.name: Oracular Visions, Lore Skill
features.description: Oracular Visions, Lore Skill

features.name: Oracular Visions
features.description: Your deity rewards you with hazy visions of things to come. Each time you earn 1 or more Victories, you earn an equal number of fate points. Whenever you or a creature within 10 squares makes a test, you can spend 1 fate point to tap into a vision of the outcome, granting that creature an edge on the test. You lose any remaining fate points when you finish a respite.

features.name: Blessing of Fate and Destiny
features.description: Your enemies suffer their fate; your allies embrace their destiny!

ability.name: Blessing of Fate and Destiny
ability.description: Your enemies suffer their fate; your allies embrace their destiny!

sections.text:
You can target yourself instead of one creature with this ability. Choose one of the following effects, which lasts until the end of the encounter or until you are dying:

* Whenever a target makes a power roll, they can roll three dice and choose which two rolls to use.
* Whenever a target makes a power roll, they must roll three dice and use the lowest two rolls.

features.name: Oracular Warning
features.description: Each time you finish a respite, you can share the vague dreams of the future granted to you by the gods with allies who finished the respite with you. These premonitions help you and your allies stay alive, granting each of you temporary Stamina equal to 10 + your level that lasts until you finish a respite.

features.name: Your Story Ends Here
features.description: You bend the fate of a foe, willing them to die.

ability.name: Your Story Ends Here
ability.description: You bend the fate of a foe, willing them to die.

roll.tier2: 14 + I corruption damage; R < [average], weakened (save ends)
roll.tier3: 19 + I corruption damage; R < [strong], weakened (save ends)

sections.text: If this damage kills the target, you and each ally within distance can spend a Recovery.

features.name: Word of Fate Denied
features.description: When an ally within 10 squares takes damage that would leave them dying, you can use a free triggered action to make yourself or another willing creature within 10 squares of you the target of the triggering damage instead. The creature you choose takes the damage and suffers any effects associated with it, and that damage can’t be reduced in any way.

features.name: Bend Fate
features.description: The gods know you must prevail, and they bless your fate.

ability.name: Bend Fate
ability.description: The gods know you must prevail, and they bless your fate.

sections.text: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, each of the target’s power rolls has its outcome improved by one tier.

resourceGains.trigger: The first time in an encounter that an ally within 10 squares of you obtains a tier 3 outcome on a power roll or an enemy within 10 squares of you obtains a tier 1 outcome on a power roll

defaultFeatures.name: Fate Prayer Effect
defaultFeatures.description: You call on the forces of fate to create a reliable future. Choose a creature within 10 squares. That creature automatically gets a tier 1 or tier 3 outcome (your choice) on their next power roll made before the end of the encounter.

features.name: Blessing of Comprehension, Lore Skill
features.description: Blessing of Comprehension, Lore Skill

features.name: Blessing of Comprehension
features.description: You can interpret diagrams and charts even if you don’t understand the language associated with them. You are considered fluent in all languages for the purpose of understanding the project source for any research or crafting project.

features.name: The Gods Command, You Obey
features.description: You speak with the voice of your saint, commanding your enemies.

ability.name: The Gods Command, You Obey
ability.description: You speak with the voice of your saint, commanding your enemies.

roll.tier2: 7 + I holy damage; P < [average], before taking damage, the target uses an ability of your choice and you choose any targets for that ability
roll.tier3: 11 + I holy damage; P < [strong], before taking damage, the target shifts up to their speed to a location you choose, uses an ability of your choice, and you choose any targets for that ability

features.name: Saint’s Epiphany
features.description: At the start of a respite, you can inspire yourself or another creature taking the same respite with divine knowledge. If the target makes a project roll during this respite, they can add 1d10 plus your Intuition score to the roll.

features.name: Invocation of Undoing
features.description: You utter a secret word of destruction known only to deities.

ability.name: Invocation of Undoing
ability.description: You utter a secret word of destruction known only to deities.

sections.text: You can choose to have this ability deal damage to and push objects, and to deal damage to buildings.

features.name: Gods’ Library
features.description: You can gain access to information you need through prayer, so that you no longer require research materials for crafting and research projects. Additionally, you add your level to project rolls you make for crafting and research projects. You also have any skills in the lore skill group you don’t already have, and you gain a number of skills from any other skill groups equal to the number of skills you had in the lore skill group before you gained this feature.

features.name: Word of Weakening
features.description: You utter a divine word that makes a foe brittle.

ability.name: Word of Weakening
ability.description: You utter a divine word that makes a foe brittle.

roll.tier1: 10 + I corruption damage; A < [weak], weakened (save ends)
roll.tier2: 15 + I corruption damage; A < [average], weakened (save ends)
roll.tier3: 21 + I corruption damage; A < [strong], weakened (save ends)

sections.text: While weakened this way, the target has damage weakness 10.

defaultFeatures.description: Choose up to five allies within 10 squares of you, or choose yourself instead of one ally. Each target gains 1 surge.

features.description: Revitalizing Ritual, Exploration Skill

features.name: Revitalizing Ritual
features.description: Each time you finish a respite, you can choose yourself or one ally who is also finishing a respite to gain the benefit of a divine ritual. The chosen character gains a bonus to their recovery value equal to your level that lasts until you finish another respite.

features.name: Wellspring of Grace
features.description: A holy light is emitted from your body, healing your allies.

ability.name: Wellspring of Grace
ability.description: A holy light is emitted from your body, healing your allies.

sections.text: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, whenever a target starts their turn in the area, they can spend a Recovery.

features.name: Blessing of Life
features.description:
* If you are a **Conduit**: Your divine presence causes those you deem worthy to recover quickly from a fight. Whenever an ally within distance of your Healing Grace ability regains Stamina, they regain additional Stamina equal to your Intuition score.
* If you are a **Censor**: Your divine presence causes those you deem worthy to recover quickly from a fight. Whenever an ally within distance of your My Life For Yours ability regains Stamina, they regain additional Stamina equal to your Presence score.

features.name: Revitalizing Grace
features.description: With a gesture, you restore your health and that of your allies.

ability.name: Revitalizing Grace
ability.description: With a gesture, you restore your health and that of your allies.
ability.target: Self and each ally in the area

sections.text: Each target can spend any number of Recoveries. Additionally, each target can end one effect on themself that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of their turn, or they can stand up if prone.

features.name: Font of Grace
features.description:
* If you are a **Conduit**: Each time you use your *Healing Grace* ability, you gain 1 piety that can be spent only on that ability during the same turn. If you don’t use this piety, it is lost. Additionally, you can use your *Minor Miracle* feature to return a creature to life even if you don’t have their remains.
* If you are a **Censor**: Each time you use your *My Life for Yours* ability, you gain 1 wrath that can be spent only on that ability during the same turn. If you don’t use this wrath, it is lost. Additionally, the target of *My Life for Yours* gains 10 temporary Stamina.

features.name: Radiance of Grace
features.description: Intense light is emitted from your body, healing your allies.

ability.name: Radiance of Grace
ability.description: Intense light is emitted from your body, healing your allies.

sections.text: You can target yourself instead of one ally with this ability. Each target can spend any number of Recoveries, can end any effects on them that are ended by a saving throw or that end at the end of their turn, and can stand up if they are prone.

resourceGains.trigger: The first time in an encounter that a creature within 10 squares regains Stamina

defaultFeatures.name: Life Prayer Effect
defaultFeatures.description: Choose yourself or one ally within 10 squares of you. That character can spend a Recovery, can end one effect on them that is ended by a saving throw or that end at the end of their turn, or can stand up if they are prone. Alternatively, you or one ally within 10 squares gains temporary Stamina equal to 2 times your Intuition score.

features.name: Blessing of Compassion, Interpersonal Skill
features.description: Blessing of Compassion, Interpersonal Skill

features.name: Blessing of Compassion
features.description:
You exude a magic aura that can soothe those willing to socially engage with you. You gain an edge on any test made to assist another creature with a test.

Additionally, when you are present at the start of a negotiation, one NPC of your choice has their patience increased by 1 (to a maximum of 5), and the first test made to influence them gains an edge.

features.name: Our Hearts Your Strength
features.description: An ally gains strength from their friends.

ability.name: Our Hearts Your Strength
ability.description: An ally gains strength from their friends.

sections.text: Until the end of the encounter or until the target is dying, at the start of each of the target’s turns, they gain a bonus to speed and a bonus to rolled damage equal to the number of allies within 10 squares of them. This bonus lasts until the start of their next turn.

features.name: Invocation of the Heart
features.description: As a main action, you forge a bond of love and friendship with a willing creature you touch. While this bond is active, you can telepathically speak with the creature over any distance, including across different worlds. Additionally, while this bond is active, you can attempt to assist the creature with any test they make regardless of their proximity to you. You can maintain only one bond at a time, and you can end a bond at any time (no action required).

features.name: Lauded by God
features.description: You beseech the gods to give your allies what they need to win the day, and the gods answer.

ability.name: Lauded by God
ability.description: You beseech the gods to give your allies what they need to win the day, and the gods answer.

sections.text: Each target gains 3 of their Heroic Resource.

features.name: Covenant of the Heart
features.description: You can maintain bonds with up to three willing creatures using your Invocation of the Heart feature.

features.name: Guided to Your Side
features.description: You concentrate on a friend and teleport to them.

ability.name: Guided to Your Side
ability.description: You concentrate on a friend and teleport to them.

sections.text: Each target is teleported to unoccupied spaces within 5 squares of a willing creature who you are bonded to with your Invocation of the Heart feature. You don’t need line of effect to the bonded creature but you must be on the same world.

features.name: Alacrity of the Heart
features.description: You speak inspiring words to a friend and spur them to incredible feats.

ability.name: Alacrity of the Heart
ability.description: You speak inspiring words to a friend and spur them to incredible feats.

sections.text: The target has an additional main action they can use on their next turn, and gains 3 of their Heroic Resource.

resourceGains.trigger: The first time in an encounter that you or any ally within 10 squares uses the Aid Attack maneuver or an ability that targets an ally

defaultFeatures.name: Love Prayer Effect
defaultFeatures.description: Each ally within 10 squares of you gains temporary Stamina equal to 2 times your Intuition score.

features.name: Faithful Friend, Exploration Skill
features.description: Faithful Friend, Exploration Skill

features.name: Faithful Friend
features.description: An animal spirit is drawn to you, sharing their senses and serving you faithfully.

ability.name: Faithful Friend
ability.description: An animal spirit is drawn to you, sharing their senses and serving you faithfully.

sections.text: You conjure a spirit that takes the form of any animal you have seen. The incorporeal animal has speed 5 and can fly, but can’t physically interact with the world. While you are within 10 squares of the spirit, you automatically sense everything that type of animal would sense, in addition to sensing your own surroundings. You can dismiss the spirit at any time (no action required). If the spirit takes any damage, they are dismissed and you take 1d10 psychic damage that can’t be reduced in any way.

features.name: Nature Judges Thee
features.description: Mystical thorned vines appear at your bidding and bind your foes.

ability.name: Nature Judges Thee
ability.description: Mystical thorned vines appear at your bidding and bind your foes.

features.name: Wode Road
features.description: As a main action, you touch a living tree and make it part of a divine transportation network. You can maintain a number of trees in your network equal to your Intuition score. Whenever you touch any tree in your network, you can use a main action to teleport yourself and any willing creatures within 10 squares of you to a tree in your network on the same world. If a tree in your network dies, it is no longer part of the network. You can remove a tree from your network no matter your distance from it, including across different worlds (no action required).

features.name: Spirit Stampede
features.description: Animal spirits run through the battlefield, trampling your foes.

ability.name: Spirit Stampede
ability.description: Animal spirits run through the battlefield, trampling your foes.

roll.tier2: 8 damage; M < [average], prone and can’t stand (save ends)
roll.tier3: 11 damage; M < [strong], prone and can’t stand (save ends)

features.name: Nature’s Bounty
features.description:
When you finish a respite, you can prepare a magic meal using local flora for any companions who rested with you. Choose two of the following benefits for creatures who consume the meal:

* Each creature gains immunity to acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic damage equal to your level. You can choose this benefit twice, choosing a different damage immunity each time.
* Each creature gains 20 temporary Stamina.
* Each creature gains a +1 bonus to speed.
* Each creature gains a +1 bonus to saving throws.
* Each creature gains an edge on tests made to influence other creatures.

Each benefit lasts until the creature who gains it finishes another respite.

features.name: Thorn Cage
features.description: Vines burst forth from the ground and bind your foe, slowly closing around them.

ability.name: Thorn Cage
ability.description: Vines burst forth from the ground and bind your foe, slowly closing around them.

sections.text: While restrained this way, the target takes 10 damage at the start of each of your turns.

resourceGains.trigger: The first time in an encounter that you or a creature within 10 squares takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic damage

defaultFeatures.name: Nature Prayer Effect
defaultFeatures.description: Vines whip up from the floor or ground within 10 squares, wrapping around a number of creatures of your choice equal to your Intuition score. You can slide each creature up to a number of squares equal to your Intuition score. The vines then fade away.

features.name: Protective Circle, Exploration Skill
features.description: Protective Circle, Exploration Skill

features.name: Protective Circle
features.description: You can spend 10 uninterrupted minutes to create a protective circle on the ground large enough to hold one size 1 creature. The circle lasts for 24 hours, until you create another, or until you dismiss it (no action required). Only creatures you designate at the time of drawing the circle can enter and exit the area. While in the protective circle, a creature can’t be targeted by strikes.

features.name: Sacred Bond
features.description: You forge a divine connection between two creatures.

ability.name: Sacred Bond
ability.description: You forge a divine connection between two creatures.

sections.text:
Until the end of the encounter, whenever one target takes damage, the other target can use a free triggered action to take the damage instead. The original target suffers any effects associated with the damage.

Additionally, whenever one target spends a Recovery, the other target can use a free triggered action to spend a Recovery.

features.name: Impervious Touch
features.description:
As a maneuver, you can touch an object with a size equal to your Intuition score or smaller and place a protective spell on it. The object has immunity all to untyped damage. You can maintain this spell on a number of objects equal to your Intuition score, and you can end the spell on any object at any time (no action required).

Additionally, you can place this spell on a building or vehicle (or a similar structure with the Director’s approval) that is of a size larger than your Intuition score. You can place the spell on only one such target at a time, and you can maintain the spell on a larger target and a number of objects equal to your Intuition score simultaneously.

features.name: Cuirass of the Gods
features.description: Your allies are covered in spiritual armor.

ability.name: Cuirass of the Gods
ability.description: Your allies are covered in spiritual armor.

sections.text: You can target yourself instead of one creature with this ability. Each target has damage immunity 5 until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Blessing of Iron
features.description: The gods send divine favor to you and your allies. While you are not dying, enemies take a bane on strikes against you or any ally within 3 squares of you.

features.name: Blessing of the Fortress
features.description: A magic circle extends out from you, barring foes from getting close.

ability.name: Blessing of the Fortress
ability.description: A magic circle extends out from you, barring foes from getting close.

sections.text: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, no enemy can approach within 5 squares of you by moving or by being force moved by any enemy. Targets can be force moved closer to you by you or your allies, or can move closer because of your movement.

resourceGains.trigger: The first time in an encounter that you or any ally within 10 squares gains temporary Stamina, or uses a triggered action to reduce incoming damage or impose a bane or double bane on an enemy’s power roll.

defaultFeatures.name: Protection Prayer Effect
defaultFeatures.description: One ally within 10 squares gains temporary Stamina equal to four times your Intuition score.

features.name: Blessing of Fortunate Weather, Exploration Skill
features.description: Blessing of Fortunate Weather, Exploration Skill

features.name: Blessing of Fortunate Weather
features.description:
Each time you finish a respite, you can decide the weather conditions within 100 squares. Until you finish another respite, the weather conditions you establish follow you through any mundane outdoor locations.

Choose one of the following types of weather, each of which grants a benefit to you and your allies:

* **Clear**: You and your allies gain an edge on tests that use the Search or Navigate skills.
* **Foggy**: You and your allies gain an edge on tests that use the Hide skill.
* **Overcast**: You and your allies gain an edge on tests that use the Endurance skill.
* **Precipitation**: When the ground is muddy or snowy, you and your allies gain an edge on tests that use the Track skill.

If you are in the same area as a creature using this or a similar feature who has chosen a different weather effect, the features negate each other where their areas overlap.

features.name: Saint’s Tempest
features.description: A raging storm appears, striking your foes with lightning and throwing them around with wind.

ability.name: Saint’s Tempest
ability.description: A raging storm appears, striking your foes with lightning and throwing them around with wind.

features.name: Windwalk
features.description: While you have 5 or more Victories, you can fly. If you can already fly, you have a +2 bonus to speed while flying instead.

features.name: Lightning Lord
features.description: Lightning bursts forth from your body in several directions.

ability.name: Lightning Lord
ability.description: Lightning bursts forth from your body in several directions.

sections.text: The targets are force moved one at a time, starting with the target nearest to you, and can be pushed into other targets in the same line.

features.name: Ride the Lightning / Thunderstruck
features.description:
Lightning and thunder infuse your body.

Ride the Lightning (Censor): Whenever you use an ability to deal rolled damage to another creature, the ability deals extra lightning damage equal to your Presence score. Additionally, if you use an ability that force moves a creature, the forced movement distance gains a bonus equal to your Presence score. While you are under the effect of your Windwalk feature, lightning enhances your locomotion to grant you a bonus to speed equal to your Might score. If Windwalk already grants you a bonus to speed, this bonus adds to that.

Thunderstruck (Conduit): Whenever you use an ability to deal lightning or sonic damage to another creature, you gain 1 surge. Additionally, if you use an ability that force moves a creature, the forced movement distance gains a bonus equal to your Intuition score.

features.name: Godstorm
features.description: You summon a divine storm that remains under your control.

ability.name: Godstorm
ability.description: You summon a divine storm that remains under your control.

sections.text: A raging storm fills the area until the end of the encounter or until you are dying. At the start of each of your turns, you can move the storm up to 5 squares (no action required). On subsequent turns while the storm is active, you can use a maneuver to make its power roll.

features.description: As a maneuver, you make your body shine brightly, illuminating your space and each square within 5 squares. This light shines through any darkness. Hidden creatures in the area are automatically revealed, and creatures in the light, including you, can’t hide. While this feature is active, you gain an edge on tests made to notice hidden objects and entrances and to detect supernatural illusions.

features.name: Light of the Burning Sun

Whenever you use an ability to deal rolled damage to another creature, that ability deals an extra 5 fire damage, or an extra 15 fire damage if the creature is undead. features.description: You call down a sphere of fire that burns your foes to ash.

features.description: Inspired Deception, Intrigue Skill

features.name: Inspired Deception
features.description: The gods favor your thievery with magic. Whenever you make a test that uses a skill you have from the intrigue skill group, you can use Intuition on the test instead of another characteristic.

features.name: Divine Comedy
features.description: You and your allies swap places to confound your foes.

ability.name: Divine Comedy
ability.description: You and your allies swap places to confound your foes.
ability.target: Self and each ally in the area

sections.text: Each target can choose another creature in the area, then swap places with that creature. The creature they choose must be able to fit into the space they leave and vice versa.

features.name: Blessing of Secrets
features.description: You project an illusory aura that makes you and allies harder to notice.

ability.name: Blessing of Secrets
ability.description: You project an illusory aura that makes you and allies harder to notice.
ability.target: Self and each ally in the area

sections.text: Each creature in the area has a double edge on tests made to hide or sneak. The aura lasts until you end it (no action required) or until a target harms or deals damage to a creature or object.

features.name: Invocation of Mystery
features.description: “Now you see us …”

ability.name: Invocation of Mystery
ability.description: “Now you see us …”
ability.target: Self and each ally in the area

sections.text: Each target is invisible until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Trinity of Trickery
features.description: Hey! I’m over here. No, here, numbskull.

ability.name: Trinity of Trickery
ability.description: Hey! I’m over here. No, here, numbskull.

sections.text: You create two illusory duplicates of the target, which appear anywhere within distance. These duplicates last until the end of the encounter. On each of their turns, the target can move each duplicate up to their speed. If the target is targeted by an ability, they can use a free triggered action to switch places with a duplicate within their line of effect, making the duplicate the target of the ability instead. When either duplicate takes damage, it is destroyed.

features.name: Night Falls
features.description: You summon darkness that thwarts only your foes.

ability.name: Night Falls
ability.description: You summon darkness that thwarts only your foes.

sections.text: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, the area is filled with magic darkness that your enemies can’t see through, but you and your allies can.

resourceGains.trigger: The first time in an encounter that you or a creature within 10 squares takes the Aid Attack or Hide maneuver

defaultFeatures.name: Trickery Prayer Effect
defaultFeatures.description: You slide one creature within 10 squares of you up to a number of squares equal to 5 + your conduit level.

features.name: Sanctified Weapon, Exploration Skill
features.description: Sanctified Weapon, Exploration Skill

features.name: Sanctified Weapon
features.description: As a respite activity, you can bless a weapon. Any creature who wields the weapon gains a +1 bonus to rolled damage with abilities that use the weapon. This benefit lasts until you finish another respite.

features.name: Blessing of Insight
features.description: The gods grant insight revealing where best to strike your enemies.

ability.name: Blessing of Insight
ability.description: The gods grant insight revealing where best to strike your enemies.

sections.text: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, each target gains 1 surge at the end of each of your turns.

features.name: Improved Sanctified Weapon
features.description: The weapon improved by your Sanctified Weapon feature grants a +3 bonus to rolled damage instead of +1.

features.name: Blade of the Heavens
features.description: A greatsword streams down from the sky, threatening to pin your foe.

ability.name: Blade of the Heavens
ability.description: A greatsword streams down from the sky, threatening to pin your foe.

roll.tier1: 8 + I damage; A < [weak], prone and restrained (save ends)
roll.tier2: 12 + I damage; A < [average], prone and restrained (save ends)
roll.tier3: 16 + I damage; A < [strong], prone and restrained (save ends)

features.name: Your Triumphs Are Remembered
features.description: The gods allow you and your companions to bask in the glory of past successes. Whenever you finish a respite, you and any other heroes who rested with you regain 1 Victory after your Victories are converted to XP. This Victory isn’t converted into XP at the end of a subsequent respite.

features.name: Righteous Phalanx
features.description: A wall of spinning swords and knives appears where you wish.

ability.name: Righteous Phalanx
ability.description: A wall of spinning swords and knives appears where you wish.

sections.text: The wall lasts until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, and can be placed in occupied squares. Creatures can enter and pass through the wall. Each enemy who enters the area for the first time in a combat round or starts their turn there takes 15 damage.

resourceGains.trigger: The first time in an encounter that you or a creature within 10 squares takes damage greater than 10 + your level in a single turn.

defaultFeatures.name: War Prayer Effect
defaultFeatures.description: Choose up to three allies within 10 squares of you, or choose yourself instead of one ally. Each target gains 2 surges.
